text: The known words are directions. Read as instructions, east and northeast could name the route by which the grid of letters is copied out: along the rows, then up the diagonals.

Every width, each of the 16 compass points as the direction of reading, lines taken either way, and east then east-northeast or northeast in two stages: 110,820 routes, then or before a repeating key on the sculpture's tables.
Shortest key that fits K4: 21 after, 25 before, as on the copies; K4 above every copy in 1 of 52 cells, a copy 0-1.
